paragraphs: Corrisoft is a supervision technology company that sells electronic monitoring tools to the agencies responsible for people serving sentences in the community. Its buyers are agencies running probation, treatment courts, pretrial release, and residential reentry programs. The company builds its offering around the AIR suite, which it says started with AIR Mobile, the first smartphone-based supervision solution.

Staff work from a web-based platform that ties the field tools together and carries case management, GPS tracking and calendar functions. Supervising administrators can also run monitoring and reporting from a Supervisor app on their own phones. On the participant side, a check-in app provides passive GPS monitoring and facial detection for scheduled or randomized check-ins. Hardware in the same suite includes a one-piece ankle monitoring device. A portable alcohol monitoring device pairs with the phone apps so tests can be taken away from an office.

Supervisors can also assign coursework, appointing participants to virtual courses from the Corrections Rehabilitation Institute through MaxxLMS and tracking their progress. An in-house call center answers participant questions and handles technical troubleshooting. The company frames the need around program violations, citing a figure of 25% of state jail populations facing incarceration for them.

quote.text: Our mission is to improve participant outcomes by enhancing accountability, communication and education.
